description: This file defines a global exception handler for a Spring Boot web application, providing centralized handling for specific exceptions and generating structured API error responses.

classes.name: GlobalExceptionHandler
classes.description: A Spring @ControllerAdvice class that handles exceptions globally and returns structured response bodies.

methods.name: baseBody
methods.description: Constructs a standardized response body with timestamp, status, error message.

methods.name: handleNotFound
methods.description: Handles ResourceNotFoundException and responds with 404 Not Found status.

methods.name: handleValidation
methods.description: Handles validation errors with 400 Bad Request and provides field error details.

methods.name: handleGeneric
methods.description: Handles all other exceptions as internal server error responses.
